allow: PowerShell($content = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/home" -UseBasicParsing; $content.Content | Out-File -FilePath "$env:TEMP\\homepage.html" -Encoding utf8; Write-Output "HTML 저장 완료: $env:TEMP\\homepage.html")

PowerShell(Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Drawing; $file = Get-Item "public\\캐릭터.png"; $img = [System.Drawing.Image]::FromFile\($file.FullName\); [PSCustomObject]@{ Name = $file.Name; Width = $img.Width; Height = $img.Height; Resolution = "$\($img.Width\) x $\($img.Height\)"; 'Size\(KB\)' = [math]::Round\($file.Length/1KB,2\); 'Size\(MB\)' = [math]::Round\($file.Length/1MB,2\) }; $img.Dispose\(\) | Format-Table -AutoSize)

PowerShell(Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Drawing; $file = Get-Item "public\\링크 사진.png"; $img = [System.Drawing.Image]::FromFile\($file.FullName\); [PSCustomObject]@{ 'File Name' = $file.Name; 'Width' = $img.Width; 'Height' = $img.Height; 'Resolution' = "$\($img.Width\) × $\($img.Height\)"; 'Size\(KB\)' = [math]::Round\($file.Length/1KB,2\); 'Size\(MB\)' = [math]::Round\($file.Length/1MB,2\); 'Added' = $file.LastWriteTime.ToString\('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'\) }; $img.Dispose\(\) | Format-List)

PowerShell(Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Drawing; $file = Get-Item "public\\og-image-v4.png"; $img = [System.Drawing.Image]::FromFile\($file.FullName\); [PSCustomObject]@{ 'File Name' = $file.Name; 'Width' = $img.Width; 'Height' = $img.Height; 'Resolution' = "$\($img.Width\) × $\($img.Height\)"; 'Size\(KB\)' = [math]::Round\($file.Length/1KB,2\); 'Size\(MB\)' = [math]::Round\($file.Length/1MB,2\); 'Created' = $file.CreationTime.ToString\('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'\) }; $img.Dispose\(\) | Format-List)
